rec: Teleport to Falador, Amulet of Glory, or Combat Bracelet
Teleport to Ardougne, Skills Necklace, or Games Necklace
rewards: Ability to purchase and use the Dwarf Multicannon.

st.t: Talk to Captain Lawgof near the Coal Truck Mining Site (north of Fishing Guild, West of McGrubor's Wood).
If you have no railings left, talk to Captain Lawgof to get more. Otherwise skip this step.
Inspect the six damaged railings on the west and south sides of the camp's fence to fix them. Zoom in to spot the bent ones. A repair can fail, so keep inspecting until each one is fixed.
Talk to Captain Lawgof after repairing the damaged railings.
Go to the top floor of the tower, south of Captain Lawgof, and get the remains there.
Return the remains to Captain Lawgof.
Enter the goblin cave, east of the Fishing Guild entrance.
Go as far north-west as you can in the cave. In the north-westernmost room, search the northernmost crate by the east wall to find Lollk.

s: Okay, I'll see what I can do.

st.t: Use the toolkit on the broken multicannon next to Captain Lawgof. Use the hook on the spring, the pliers on the safety switch at the bottom, then the toothed tool on the gear at the bottom.
Talk to Captain Lawgof after repairing the multicannon.
Talk to Nulodion at the Dwarven Black Guard camp, south of Ice Mountain.
Return to Captain Lawgof with the ammo mould and Nulodion's Notes.
